subject: physics
content: A thin and uniform rod of mass M and length L is held vertical on a floor with large friction. The rod is released from rest so that it falls by rotating about its contact-point with the floor without slipping. Which of the following statement(s) is/are correct, when the rod makes an angle 60<mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: 0;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="0.988ex" height="1.532ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -677 436.6 677" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="msup"><g data-mml-node="mi"></g><g data-mml-node="mo" transform="translate(33,363) scale(0.707)"><use data-c="2218" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-2218"></use></g></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container> with vertical? [g is the acceleration due to gravity]
